candidates.new:
.calculate_mover_x_max_from_offset
    LDX &C5
    LDA frame_and_flip              \ grind: the flip into C instead of N: the ADC below runs with C=0 and the SBC with C=1,
    ASL A                           \ so neither needs its CLC/SEC (Y, was LDY frame_and_flip, is dead after: every caller reloads it)
    LDA mover_x_low
    BCS is_flipped_2aa5
.not_flipped_2a9a
    ADC mover_x_offset              \ C=0 from the ASL
    STA mover_x_max_low             \ Leave with mover_x_max = mover_x + x_offset,
    STX mover_x_max_high            \ mover_x = mover_x if unflipped
    BCS skip_overflow_2aa0          \ grind: the carry (never measured) taken, not the common case
    RTS
.skip_overflow_2aa0
    INC mover_x_max_high
    RTS
.is_flipped_2aa5
    STA mover_x_max_low             \ Leave with mover_x_max = mover_x,
    STX mover_x_max_high            \ grind: stored here, not before the BCS (the unflipped path stores its own)
    SBC mover_x_offset              \ mover_x = mover_x - x_offset if flipped (C=1 from the ASL)
    STA mover_x_low
    BCC cmx_borrow_c894             \ grind: the borrow (a quarter of the flips) out of line, so the common no-borrow case falls to the RTS
    RTS
.cmx_borrow_c894
    DEC &C5                         \ grind: was DEX/STX &C5 (X is dead after: every caller reloads it)
    RTS
candidates.summary: calculate_mover_x_max_from_offset: test the flip into the carry (LDA frame_and_flip / ASL A, then LDA mover_x_low) instead of N, so the unflipped ADC runs on C=0 and the flipped SBC on C=1 and the CLC and SEC go (equal cycles: the LDY is replaced by the ASL, 13 either way). The flipped path's borrow DEC &C5 moves out of line behind a BCC, so the common no-borrow case is a not-taken branch (2) and the RTS instead of a taken BCS (3): -1 on the flipped no-borrow path, +1 on the borrow path (about 3:1 measured). Net 0 bytes (the saved SEC is spent on the extra RTS), every label after the window keeps its address.
candidates.equivalence: Same results in A, X, C, N, Z, V and in memory on every path. Unflipped (frame_and_flip bit 7 clear): ASL leaves C=0, BCS not taken, ADC runs as after CLC; stores, BCS skip_overflow and INC unchanged. Flipped (bit 7 set): ASL leaves C=1, BCS taken, the stores of A=mover_x_low and X=&C5 as before, SBC runs as after SEC, STA mover_x_low; no borrow (C=1) now falls to RTS, borrow (C=0) goes to DEC &C5 then RTS, as before. The only difference is Y on return: it was frame_and_flip and now is whatever the caller had. Y is dead after: the dataflow liveness at every RTS here is 'in:- out:-'; caller 1 (enter_or_leave_helicopter, via _getting_frame_and_flip, which reloads from memory as before) goes on to LDA #/STA/LDX #/JSR check_for_mover_collision_with_range_of_movers, whose entry reads no Y, and whose last-two-checks rule overwrites Y before return; caller 2 (search_for_target) reloads Y (LDY target) before every use and check_for_mover_collision_with_mover_X/check_if_friendly set their own; caller 3 (consider_mover_firing_grenade) is followed by JSR get_mover_frame_and_flip, which starts LDY mover_to_update. frame_and_flip is only read, as before. No entry past a label (grep: no 'calculate_mover_x_max_from_offset +', no use of is_flipped_2aa5, not_flipped_2a9a or set_mover_x outside the window; set_mover_x is removed, its only user was the BCS). The self-modified operands are not touched.
candidates.relies_on: Y dead after calculate_mover_x_max_from_offset (all three callers, checked above). Bytes: old 35 (&2759-&277B), new 35: LDX2 LDA2 ASL1 LDA2 BCS2 (9, was LDX LDA LDY BMI CLC = 9), unflipped ADC2 STA2 STX2 BCS2 RTS1 INC2 RTS1, flipped STA2 STX2 SBC2 STA2 BCC2 RTS1 DEC2 RTS1 (was SEC1 + BCS2 + DEC2 + RTS1); skip_overflow_2aa0 stays at &276B, is_flipped_2aa5 at &276E, check_for_collision_with_friends at &277C, so no code after the window moves and no page crossing changes (all branches here are inside page &27; BCS to is_flipped stays taken-3 for flipped as BMI was). Per-path cycles: unflipped 30 -> 30; flipped no-borrow 35 -> 34; flipped borrow 39 -> 40; borrow share from the window's measured BCS/DEC lines is 0.36 of the 1.45 flipped executions a pass, so -1.09 +0.36 = -0.73 cycles a pass.
